messages.text:
"Create a very simple playable 3D horror prototype called THE LAST SHIFT.

Requirements:

- One small abandoned dark room.
- First-person camera.
- Player movement using mobile touch controls.
- Camera rotation.
- A flashlight with an ON/OFF button.
- A single interactive door.
- Basic 3D lighting and shadows.

Use Three.js if available.

Keep the code simple, lightweight and compatible with Android browsers.

Do not add monsters, complex AI, multiple levels or advanced features yet.

Make sure the game builds successfully and is actually playable.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
